title: HTTPS, MCP and Wire authority boundaries
summary: HTTPS owns TLS/HTTP and authenticated exchange context; MCP owns protocol translation; McpProjectWireService owns project semantics and returns WireUIResult. MCP never edits project persistence directly.
invariants: Do not turn project operations into fake Wire UI_ACTION events.
Do not let the HTTPS route mutate the journal/catalogue directly.
A future Wire UI or remote Wire proxy must consume the same semantic service contract.

provenance.claim: Grounded in sealed MCP Project Service v0.2-dev7 package.
